_about: Jared's catch lines (Nov 10, 2026), from his Paragon closed sales Nov 2025 to Oct 2026 and agents' public remarks (area-catch-notes.xlsx). Checked against src/data/sold/sold-12m.json, TransLink (West Coast Express schedule), the Surrey Langley SkyTrain station list and City of Delta flood material. 'final' is the wording to publish; 'changed' says what was adjusted and why.

abbotsford-east-guide.final: Hilly streets: expect stairs, sloped yards and driving for most errands, with limited bus service.

bear-creek-green-timbers-guide.final: Mostly 1980s homes, some really priced as lot value, and most sellers took under asking.
bear-creek-green-timbers-guide.second: SkyTrain construction runs along Fraser Highway, with Green Timbers Station at 140 Street, until the line opens (expected late 2029).
bear-creek-green-timbers-guide.changed: construction line added: station list on surreylangleyskytrain.gov.bc.ca

clayton-guide.final: Dense and newer, with small lots, tandem garages and tight street parking.
clayton-guide.second: Clayton Station is being built at 190 Street and Fraser Highway, so expect construction on Fraser Highway until the line opens (expected late 2029).
clayton-guide.changed: none; construction line added from the official station list

east-newton-guide.final: Older complexes, many of them 55+; detached homes have sat longer and mostly sold under asking.
east-newton-guide.changed: 'older stock' narrowed to the complexes: detached houses that sold had a median build year of 2002

panorama-ridge-guide.final: Car-first suburb off Highway 10 and Scott Road; many homes are from the 1990s and due for updates.

sullivan-station-guide.final: Mostly newer townhomes with tandem garages; detached lots are small and slower to sell.

sunnyside-park-surrey-guide.final: Mostly older complexes, many 55+, with higher strata fees; nearly all sales closed under asking.

northwest-maple-ridge-guide.final: Mostly 1980s homes, and most commutes are by car over the Golden Ears Bridge or along Lougheed.

cottonwood-maple-ridge-guide.final: Still filling in, with ongoing townhouse and infill building, tandem garages and smaller lots.

thornhill-maple-ridge-guide.final: Part rural: acreages on septic, very few buses, and homes have taken longer to sell.
thornhill-maple-ridge-guide.changed: 'Rural' -> 'Part rural': the detached houses that sold had a median build year of 2011 on 4,300 sq ft lots, beside 6 acreages; small sample (27 sales)

mission-bc-mission-guide.final: Long commute west. The West Coast Express runs weekdays only, into Vancouver in the morning and back in the evening, and homes take longer to sell.
mission-bc-mission-guide.changed: WCE wording checked on TransLink: weekday rush hours only, 5 trains westbound in the morning and 5 eastbound in the evening

ladner-elementary-guide.final: Low-lying behind the dikes, near the river and farmland, with older detached homes and higher strata fees.
ladner-elementary-guide.changed: 'slower sales lately' dropped: houses sold in a median 18 days on market (44 sales, small sample). 'Floodplain' not claimed; Delta's lowlands sit behind its dike system (City of Delta), and river-side lots can carry flood-proofing covenants, which goes in Before you buy.
